A '''battle''' in [[Yablari system/Legends|Yablari system]] occurred in the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Sith Empire]], in [[3996 BBY]]. At [[Yablari/Legends|Yablari]], the two sides fought with the Sith emerging as the victors.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Yablari makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.
